questions.question: What is the primary purpose of Setups in Robot Framework?

options.text: To prepare the environment or system for execution or verify that requirements/preconditions are met
To clean up resources after test execution completes
options.explanation: Cleanup is the purpose of Teardowns, not Setups

options.text: To define variables that will be used during test execution
options.explanation: While Setups may set variables, their primary purpose is environment preparation and precondition verification

options.text: To log test execution metadata for reporting purposes
options.explanation: Logging is a side effect; the primary purpose is preparation and precondition verification

questions.question: At which levels can Setups be defined in Robot Framework?

options.text: Suite level
Test|Task level
Keyword level
Variable level
options.explanation: There is no Setup concept at the variable level

options.text: Library level
options.explanation: Setups are not defined at the library level

questions.question: What is a Setup in Robot Framework?

options.text: A single keyword with potential argument values that is called before other execution
A sequence of keywords that must all pass for execution to proceed
options.explanation: A Setup is a single keyword call, not a sequence (though that keyword can contain multiple steps)

options.text: A configuration file that defines test parameters
options.explanation: Setups are keyword calls, not configuration files

options.text: A special section in Robot Framework files like *** Setup ***
options.explanation: There is no *** Setup *** section; Setups are defined using settings

questions.question: Which of these are typical use cases for Setups?

options.text: Establishing connections to databases or services
Initializing test data or configurations
Setting the system under test to a known state
Logging into applications or systems
Generating test execution reports
options.explanation: Report generation happens after execution, not during setup

questions.question: When is a Suite Setup executed?

options.text: Before any tests|tasks or child suites within the suite are run
Before each test|task in the suite individually
options.explanation: This describes Test Setup, not Suite Setup

options.text: After all tests|tasks in the suite complete but before child suites
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs before execution, not after

options.text: Only before the first test|task, but not before child suites
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs before all tests and child suites

questions.question: What happens if a Suite Setup fails?

options.text: All tests|tasks in the suite and its child suites are marked as failed and not executed
Only the first test|task is marked as failed; the rest continue executing
options.explanation: All tests in the suite fail when Suite Setup fails

options.text: The suite setup is retried once before failing the suite
options.explanation: There is no automatic retry mechanism for Suite Setup

options.text: Robot Framework continues with a warning but executes all tests|tasks
options.explanation: Suite Setup failure prevents all test execution in that suite

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup    Initialize Environment    dataset=Config_C3
```

What does this Suite Setup do?

options.text: Calls the 'Initialize Environment' keyword with a named argument dataset=Config_C3 before any tests run
Calls 'Initialize Environment' before each test with the dataset parameter
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs once before all tests, not before each test

options.text: Defines a variable named dataset with value Config_C3
options.explanation: This is a keyword call with an argument, not a variable definition

options.text: Imports the Initialize Environment library with configuration
options.explanation: This is calling a keyword, not importing a library

questions.question: What is a key benefit of using Suite Setup instead of Test Setup for common preparation?

options.text: It saves time by executing the action only once before all tests|tasks instead of before each one
It provides better error messages when setup fails
options.explanation: Error message quality is similar; the benefit is execution efficiency

options.text: It allows for more complex keyword logic
options.explanation: Both can call the same keywords; the difference is timing and frequency

options.text: It is required for suites with child suites
options.explanation: Suite Setup is optional; it's used when beneficial for efficiency

questions.question: Which are typical use cases for Suite Setup?

options.text: Checking preconditions that must be met before running the tests|tasks
Starting services or applications required for the suite
Loading configurations or resources shared across multiple tests|tasks
Setting up data unique to each individual test|task
options.explanation: Test-specific data setup is done in Test Setup, not Suite Setup

questions.question: When is a Test|Task Setup executed?

options.text: Before a single test|task runs
Before all tests|tasks in the suite
options.explanation: This describes Suite Setup, not Test Setup

options.text: After the test|task body but before teardown
options.explanation: Setup runs before the test body, not after

options.text: Only if the previous test|task passed
options.explanation: Test Setup runs regardless of previous test results

questions.question: Where can you define a default Test|Task Setup that applies to all tests|tasks in a suite?

options.text: In the *** Settings *** section using the Test Setup or Task Setup setting
In the *** Variables *** section as ${TEST_SETUP}
options.explanation: Test Setup is a setting, not a variable

options.text: In each test|task using the [Setup] tag
options.explanation: [Setup] is for individual test overrides, not default settings

options.text: In a separate setup.robot resource file
options.explanation: Default Test Setup is defined in the suite's *** Settings *** section

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Test Setup    Login As Standard User

*** Test Cases ***
Admin Access Test
    [Setup]    Login As Admin
    Perform Admin Actions    007
```

What setup will be executed for the 'Admin Access Test'?

options.text: Login As Admin (the local [Setup] overrides the default Test Setup)
Both Login As Standard User and Login As Admin (both are executed)
options.explanation: Local [Setup] completely overrides the default, both are not executed

options.text: Login As Standard User (default Test Setup always applies)
options.explanation: Local [Setup] overrides the default Test Setup

options.text: No setup (the [Setup] tag disables setup for this test)
options.explanation: [Setup] with a keyword name calls that keyword; only [Setup] NONE disables setup

questions.question: How do you disable a Test|Task Setup for a specific test|task?

options.text: Use [Setup] NONE in the test|task
Use [Setup] ${EMPTY} in the test|task
options.explanation: NONE is the specific keyword to disable setup, not ${EMPTY}

options.text: Omit the [Setup] setting from the test|task
options.explanation: Omitting [Setup] means the default Test Setup will be used if defined

options.text: Use [Disable Setup] in the test|task
options.explanation: There is no [Disable Setup] setting; use [Setup] NONE

questions.question: What happens if a Test|Task Setup fails?

options.text: The test|task is marked as failed, and its body (main keywords) is not executed
The test|task body is executed with a warning about the failed setup
options.explanation: Test body is not executed when setup fails

options.text: All remaining tests|tasks in the suite are also marked as failed
options.explanation: Only the current test fails; other tests continue (unlike Suite Setup failure)

options.text: The setup is automatically retried before failing the test|task
options.explanation: There is no automatic retry mechanism for Test Setup

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Test Setup    Login As Standard User

*** Test Cases ***
No Setup Test
    [Setup]    NONE
    Perform Actions Without Login    000
```

Is NONE case-sensitive in this context?

options.text: Yes, NONE must be in uppercase to disable the setup
No, none, None, or NONE all work the same way
options.explanation: The syllabus specifically states NONE is case-sensitive

options.text: Yes, but only when used with Test Setup, not other setup types
options.explanation: NONE is case-sensitive for all setup types

options.text: No, Robot Framework is case-insensitive for all keywords and settings
options.explanation: While keywords are generally case-insensitive, NONE is a special case-sensitive value

questions.question: Which are typical use cases for Test|Task Setup?

options.text: Setting up data unique to the test|task
Executing preparation steps to navigate to the automated task or feature under test
Distinguishing phases of a test|task (setup, steps, teardown)
Starting services needed by all tests in the suite
options.explanation: Suite-wide services should be started in Suite Setup, not Test Setup

questions.question: When is a Keyword Setup executed?

options.text: Before the body of a user keyword is executed
Before any test that calls the keyword
options.explanation: Keyword Setup runs only when that specific keyword is called, not before tests

options.text: After the keyword's arguments are processed but before return values are set
options.explanation: Keyword Setup runs before the keyword body, which includes all execution

options.text: Only the first time the keyword is called in a suite
options.explanation: Keyword Setup runs every time the keyword is called

questions.question:
```robot
*** Keywords ***
Process Data
    [Setup]    Open Data Connection
    Process the Data
    Close Data Connection
```

What happens if 'Open Data Connection' fails?

options.text: The keyword's body ('Process the Data' and 'Close Data Connection') is not executed
Only 'Process the Data' is skipped, but 'Close Data Connection' still runs
options.explanation: The entire keyword body is skipped when Keyword Setup fails

options.text: The keyword retries the setup once before failing
options.explanation: There is no automatic retry for Keyword Setup

options.text: The keyword body executes with a warning about the failed setup
options.explanation: The keyword body is not executed when setup fails

questions.question: Which are typical use cases for Keyword Setup?

options.text: Opening connections or files needed by the keyword
Initializing variables or data structures
Ensuring preconditions specific to the keyword are met
Logging into applications before running any tests
options.explanation: Application login for tests is typically done in Suite or Test Setup, not Keyword Setup

questions.question: How are Setups logged in the execution log?

options.text: As a separate section, indicating the setup status
As the first keyword in the test|task|keyword body
options.explanation: Setups are logged separately from the body, not as part of it

options.text: Only if they fail; successful setups are not logged
options.explanation: All setups are logged regardless of success or failure

options.text: In the *** Settings *** section of the log file
options.explanation: Setups are logged in the execution flow, not in a settings section

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup     Start Application Server
Test Setup      Login As Standard User

*** Test Cases ***
Test One
    Perform Action A

Test Two
    [Setup]    Login As Admin
    Perform Action B
```

What is the execution order for 'Test One'?

options.text: Start Application Server → Login As Standard User → Perform Action A
Login As Standard User → Start Application Server → Perform Action A
options.explanation: Suite Setup always runs before Test Setup

options.text: Start Application Server → Perform Action A (Test Setup doesn't run for Test One)
options.explanation: Default Test Setup applies unless overridden or disabled

options.text: Login As Standard User → Perform Action A (Suite Setup only runs once for the entire suite)
options.explanation: While Suite Setup runs once, it runs before Test One as the first test

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup     Start Application Server
Test Setup      Login As Standard User

*** Test Cases ***
Test Two
    [Setup]    Login As Admin
    Perform Action B
```

If 'Test Two' is the second test in the suite, what is its execution order?

options.text: Login As Admin → Perform Action B (Suite Setup already ran before the first test)
Start Application Server → Login As Admin → Perform Action B
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs only once before all tests, not before each test

options.text: Login As Standard User → Login As Admin → Perform Action B
options.explanation: The local [Setup] completely overrides the default Test Setup

options.text: Start Application Server → Login As Standard User → Login As Admin → Perform Action B
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs once, and local Setup overrides default Test Setup

questions.question: What is a key characteristic that all Setup levels (Suite, Test|Task, Keyword) share?

options.text: They are all single keyword calls with potential argument values
They can all be disabled using the NONE keyword
options.explanation: Only Test|Task Setup and Keyword Setup can be disabled with NONE in individual items

options.text: They all affect the execution of all tests in the suite if they fail
options.explanation: Only Suite Setup failure affects all tests; Test and Keyword Setup failures are more limited

options.text: They are all optional but recommended for every suite
options.explanation: While optional, not every suite needs every type of setup

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup    Initialize Database

*** Test Cases ***
First Test
    Query Database
    Verify Results

Second Test
    Update Database
    Verify Update
```

If 'Initialize Database' fails, what happens?

options.text: Both 'First Test' and 'Second Test' are marked as failed and not executed
Only 'First Test' fails; 'Second Test' attempts to run
options.explanation: Suite Setup failure prevents all tests from executing

options.text: Both tests run but with a warning about the failed setup
options.explanation: Tests do not run when Suite Setup fails

options.text: Robot Framework retries 'Initialize Database' before failing
options.explanation: There is no automatic retry for Suite Setup

questions.question: What distinguishes the phases of a test|task when using Test|Task Setup?

options.text: Setup (preparation/precondition checking), test body (steps), and teardown (cleanup/postconditions)
Initialization, execution, and reporting
options.explanation: These are general execution phases, not the specific setup/body/teardown structure

options.text: Import, configure, and execute
options.explanation: These don't describe test phases with setup

options.text: Start, process, and finish
options.explanation: The correct terminology is setup, body, and teardown

questions.question:
```robot
*** Keywords ***
Send Email
    [Arguments]    ${recipient}    ${subject}    ${body}
    [Setup]    Connect To Email Server
    Compose Email    ${recipient}    ${subject}    ${body}
    Send Message
    [Teardown]    Disconnect From Email Server
```

How many times will 'Connect To Email Server' be called if 'Send Email' is called 3 times?

options.text: 3 times (once each time Send Email is called)
1 time (Keyword Setup runs once per suite)
options.explanation: Keyword Setup runs every time the keyword is called, not once per suite

options.text: 0 times (Keyword Setup is optional and not executed by default)
options.explanation: When defined, Keyword Setup is executed every time the keyword is called

options.text: 2 times (first and last call only)
options.explanation: Keyword Setup runs on every call, not just first and last

questions.question: Which statement about Suite Setup execution is correct?

options.text: It executes once before any tests|tasks and child suites in the suite
It executes before each test|task but only once per child suite
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs once before everything, not before each test

options.text: It executes before each child suite but not before tests|tasks
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs once before both tests and child suites

options.text: It executes in parallel with child suite setups for efficiency
options.explanation: Execution is sequential, not parallel

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Test Setup    Prepare Test Environment

*** Test Cases ***
Test With Setup
    Execute Test Steps

Test Without Setup
    [Setup]    NONE
    Execute Test Steps

Test With Custom Setup
    [Setup]    Prepare Special Environment
    Execute Test Steps
```

Which tests will execute 'Prepare Test Environment'?

options.text: Only 'Test With Setup'
'Test With Setup' and 'Test With Custom Setup'
options.explanation: 'Test With Custom Setup' overrides the default with its own setup

options.text: All three tests (default applies unless explicitly removed)
options.explanation: 'Test Without Setup' uses NONE and 'Test With Custom Setup' has a different setup

options.text: None, because individual [Setup] declarations override the default for all tests
options.explanation: Only tests without [Setup] use the default; 'Test With Setup' has no [Setup] so uses default

questions.question: What is the benefit of using Keyword Setup for resource management?

options.text: It ensures resources are properly initialized before the keyword body executes and are isolated to that keyword's scope
It shares resource connections across all keywords for better performance
options.explanation: Keyword Setup is per-keyword execution, not shared across keywords

options.text: It automatically retries resource connection failures
options.explanation: There is no automatic retry mechanism in Keyword Setup

options.text: It prevents other keywords from accessing the same resources simultaneously
options.explanation: Keyword Setup doesn't provide resource locking or exclusive access

questions.question:
```robot
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup     Verify System Requirements
Test Setup      Initialize Test Data

*** Keywords ***
Complex Operation
    [Setup]    Acquire Resource Lock
    Perform Operation
    [Teardown]    Release Resource Lock

*** Test Cases ***
Test Complex Operation
    Complex Operation
```

What is the complete execution order for 'Test Complex Operation'?

options.text: Verify System Requirements → Initialize Test Data → Acquire Resource Lock → Perform Operation → Release Resource Lock
Initialize Test Data → Verify System Requirements → Acquire Resource Lock → Perform Operation → Release Resource Lock
options.explanation: Suite Setup runs before Test Setup

options.text: Verify System Requirements → Acquire Resource Lock → Initialize Test Data → Perform Operation → Release Resource Lock
options.explanation: Test Setup runs before the test body (which includes calling Complex Operation with its Keyword Setup)

options.text: Initialize Test Data → Acquire Resource Lock → Verify System Requirements → Perform Operation → Release Resource Lock
options.explanation: Suite Setup always runs first, then Test Setup, then the keyword with its setup
